description: OpenBMB VoxCPM 0.5B tokenizer-free TTS model supporting short-reference voice cloning and streaming output (16kHz).

request.name: seed
request.description: Random seed for MiniCPM and diffusion sampling.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum MiniCPM output tokens; default 4096. Zero selects model max_length; negative counts are rejected.

request.name: min_tokens
request.description: Minimum MiniCPM output tokens before an EOS stop is honored; default 2.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: CFM diffusion sampling steps; default 10. Must be positive.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: CFM classifier-free guidance rate. Must be nonnegative.

request.name: retry_badcase
request.description: Retry when generation is detected as a bad case; defaults to true offline and false in streaming. Streaming ignores an explicit true value with a warning.

request.name: retry_badcase_max_times
request.description: Maximum total generation attempts when retrying bad cases, including the initial attempt; default 3. Must be positive.

request.name: retry_badcase_ratio_threshold
request.description: Bad-case ratio threshold for retry decisions. Must be positive.

request.name: prompt_text
request.description: Text prompt for prompt-continuation voice cloning.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Alias for prompt_text; text prompt for prompt-continuation voice cloning.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum characters per offline text chunk; must be positive. Does not control streaming chunk cadence.

request.name: language
request.description: Language hint for Chinese-script normalization; Cantonese/yue preserves Traditional characters. Inherits structured transcript or voice language when provided.

session.name: lora
session.description: Native LoRA directory or checkpoint file with adjacent lora_config.json; merged into generator weights at session creation.

session.name: lora_scale
session.description: Multiplier for the adapter's configured alpha/r scaling; default 1.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Use tighter graph workspaces and release request runtime graphs; default false.

session.name: prompt_cache_slots
session.description: Prompt and prompt-audio embedding cache slots; default 1.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Model weight graph context size in MB.

session.name: text_embedding_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Text embedding host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: lm_step_graph_arena_mb
session.description: LM step host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: projection_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Projection host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: local_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Local encoder host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: dit_graph_arena_mb
session.description: DiT estimator host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: audiovae_weight_context_mb
session.description: AudioVAE weight graph context size in MB.

session.name: audiovae_graph_arena_mb
session.description: AudioVAE decoder host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: audiovae_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: AudioVAE encoder host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.
